body:
Build brief. Game rules approved by Karolis 30-31 Oct. Read each rule entry before building.
ONE NEED (rules-dec-one-need, 31 Oct, replaces two and four): happiness only, NO hunger. Food, petting, playing, toys, naps and the favourite thing all raise it (like today's single happy value). Body language when unhappy: brings a toy, bounces, yawns, follows close, nudges, sniffs or sits by the empty bowl. Old saves: happiness stays.
SICKNESS (rules-sickness): sick when very unhappy for long. Real play minutes only; away = paused. Body language only. No tricks or Pet Show while sick. Only the vet cures. Never dies or runs away. Ms. Paws won't take a sick pet. Doesn't spread. Old saves: all pets healthy.
VET VISIT (rules-vet-visit): book on the phone (any time, for open hours) or with the lobby nurse (while open); only sick pets; 2-game-hour window; nobody booked = walk in; late = book again, no coins lost. Vet checks, nurse gives a treat. Cured at NORMAL mood. One visit treats every sick pet following you, pay per pet. Can't pay = free (rules-q-vet-broke B). Farm animals never visit. No vet job for players.
CARE HELPERS: home bowl + toys = home pets lose happiness at half speed; pets nap when you sleep; friends pet and play, no feeding; free nurse tip; warning sneeze ~15 min before sick; healthy week is per player: no pet sick + care on 3+ days Mon-Fri (care day = fed or played with your pets) -> all your pets wear the ribbon and it counts for the animal license. Bear and seal nap in their own home (den, pond).
FRIENDS SEE PETS FOR REAL (Karolis, 31 Oct): send each pet's mood, sick state and current move online, so friends see the same moves. Build notes: friends' pet copies carry no mood today; add 'sick' at the END of the pet array so old versions ignore it. Unknown: one player on two devices must not lose happiness twice.
ORDER: build sickness in stage 2 but keep it switched off until the vet clinic (stage 4) is in the game.
FOOD (rules-food, approved 31 Oct): 3 food groups, no new items: Meat (dogs, owl, bear, snake) = old Pet food; Fish (cat, seal) = old Cat food; Fruit & veggies (bunny, hamster, capybara, duck, monkey) = old Bunny & hamster food; Treats for all. Same ids. Every pet eats every food: group food +40, others and treats +30 (treats cheaper). Each pet type has one food-group word, not a food list. Bowl: one food lasts one game day of play. No food in bag: 'Ms. Paws sells meat, fish, fruit & veggies.' Shop: each food says who loves it. Change the quest step text (js/03-game.js ~274), the some-food word list (~321), and ACT.pfeed refusing foods (js/04-panels.js).
MOVES (#moves, stage pfu-2): moves-pack (all OK'd moves as code for the game's models), moves-pet-nap-home, moves-pet-eat (new: eat from bowl or hand), moves-jointed-test (Karolis picks after).
SCREENS: screens-vet-app (Book the vet button in the Pets app; Leo's desk opens the same screen; buttons at least 44 px). Sounds: screens-sounds (tone() recipes as given).
CHECK: measure the iPad frame rate with 2 players x 3 following pets (friends see real moves).
PET BRAIN DETAILS (rules-pet-brain-details, 31 Oct): moods follow today's hearts (happiness / 20): 5 very very happy, 3-4 happy, 2 normal, 0-1 sad; sick after ~1 more hour of play at 0-1 hearts; babies can enter the Pet Show; growing up keeps counting while sick.
NUMBERS (Schedules and economy, approved 31 Oct): vet 50 coins per pet treated, free with too few coins; vet open 7:00-23:00 every day = 8 two-hour booking windows. Food prices as today: 6 each, treats 5.
SHOP FOOD LABELS (screens-food-labels): Meat / Fish / Fruit & veggies, a 'who loves it' line of animal faces under each; Treats: '🐾 all love it'.
PLAY TEST (bug-pets-left-behind, never play-checked): long walks with 3 following pets past corners and fences, on Friends Lane and at the beach; pets must not be left behind. Also bear and seal waiting outside.
BEFORE BUILDING: pre-mortem with Karolis (pet brain is the biggest new system).
MOVES PACK (31 Oct, all moves OK'd by Karolis): book tools/moves-pack/ v4 (moves-pack.js, README with every move, trigger and prop position). Pets keep today's legs (no knees, Karolis picked B). Limits: people hop up steps, hands stop short of low targets. Polish later (moves-polish-later).

comments.text: What changed: two needs not four; vet free if broke; pay per pet.
Game rules chat: added 2 rules you approved after this plan was written (healthy week per player, bear and seal nap at home).

Added: moves, screens and placements for this stage. Food groups.
Game rules chat: food details from rules check 5 added (Karolis OK'd). Still approved.
Game rules chat: pet brain details added (moods, babies, growing up). Still approved.
Plan: approved vet numbers, food labels, pets-left-behind play test added. Still approved.
Added: latest moves, people and map notes (31 Oct).

short: Stage 2: one need (happiness), sickness, vet visit, food, care helpers
